issues.description: Function naming/signature mismatch for the measurement routine in the DD simulator: the problem statement and solution refer to dd_measure_all(...), but the template defines measure_all_dd(...). This difference in the function name is structural (part of the public API students must implement) and will confuse students about which function to implement and how tests will call the measurement routine.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template API match the problem statement and solution. Rename the template function measure_all_dd to dd_measure_all (preserving the same signature), or add a small wrapper dd_measure_all that calls measure_all_dd so both names are supported. Update any references/comments in the template to consistently use dd_measure_all.

issues.description: The problem statement and solution use the function name dd_measure_all for measuring samples, but the template declares the function as measure_all_dd. This inconsistent identifier for the same conceptual operation (measuring all qubits and returning counts) creates unnecessary mapping confusion for students and may cause tests or example usage to fail if they call dd_measure_all but the template defines measure_all_dd.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the template function measure_all_dd to dd_measure_all (and update any internal references) so the template, problem statement, and solution consistently use dd_measure_all for the measurement routine.
